summary_en: This study tests recording of brain electrical activity within and around high-grade glioma tumors during surgery, in people with high-grade glioma, including glioblastoma. Participants undergo intraoperative electrocorticography through a subdural grid and depth electrode during their surgery, and a small tissue biopsy is taken at the recording sites; how long or how often is not stated. The stated purpose is to test safety and feasibility, the main outcome measure is not stated, and the record lists the study as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el registro de la actividad eléctrica cerebral dentro y alrededor de tumores de glioma de alto grado, durante la cirugía, en personas con glioma de alto grado, incluido el glioblastoma. Los participantes se someten a electrocorticografía intraoperatoria mediante una rejilla subdural y un electrodo de profundidad durante la cirugía, y se toma una pequeña biopsia de tejido en los sitios de registro; la duración o frecuencia no está indicada. El propósito declarado es evaluar la seguridad y la factibilidad, la medida de resultado principal no está indicada, y el registro clasifica el estudio como Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with high-grade glioma suspected on MRI, confirmed on frozen tissue check.
Adults with a past confirmed high-grade glioma having surgery for a likely recurrent or progressive tumor.
Karnofsky performance status of 60 or higher.
Considered appropriate for neurosurgery, with blood counts and clotting tests in range within 1 month before surgery.
Able to give written informed consent.
not_for: Severe health problems that the treating physician judges raise surgical risk too much.
Other major medical illness or psychiatric condition that would prevent completing the protocol.
Clotting or platelet problems that raise the risk of bleeding.
Tumor located in an eloquent or critical brain area, as judged by the neurosurgeon.
